name: Pre Matric Scholarship for Students belonging to Scheduled Caste Community
benefit: Financial assistance is provided to the students. _*The scheme is funded by the Ministry of Tribal Affairs and the Government of Mizoram in 90:10 ratio._
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be permanently settled in Mizoram. 1. The applicant must belong to Scheduled Caste. 1. The income of the parents/guardians of the applicant (from all sources) should not exceed ₹2,50,000/- per annum. 1. The applicant must be studying either in 9th or 10th standard.
